title: Twin knocked out when brother is sedated

tellings.quote: So he gave me a shot of something to knock me out and a minute later, Jack goes out cold.

plain: In the late 1950s near Allentown, Pennsylvania, a family doctor gave Jim Weiner a shot to knock him out, and a minute later his twin brother Jack, who had not been given anything, went out cold too. Jim Weiner tells this from his own life and says a report from the family doctor and an article in the local newspaper recorded it. He tells it to suggest an unusual bond between the twins, who would later describe a shared alien abduction.
